fml.menu.mods.info.description.stonecutt: A renewable-resource sifting system for OneBlock, SkyBlock, and limited worlds. Drop supported blocks onto a Stonecutter to roll useful materials.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.processing: Dropped blocks: 1 item every 4 ticks per Stonecutter
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.sand: One exclusive Sand roll plus an independent 0.25% Sniffer Egg roll. The Sniffer Egg does not replace the normal Sand result.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.red_sand: Desert-mineral table. 40% of processed Red Sand contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.gravel: Flint is guaranteed. 50% of Gravel gets a bonus package; successful packages have a 30% chance for a second common roll. Diamond is exactly 1% overall.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.soul_sand: One exclusive Nether-themed roll per Soul Sand.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.dirt: 40% nothing, 30% Bone Meal, 15% seed-family, 15% sapling-family. The non-oak sapling roll reads #minecraft:saplings dynamically.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.rooted_dirt: Lush Caves starter table. 30% of processed Rooted Dirt contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.moss: Lush Caves expansion table. 35% of processed Moss contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.clay: Aquatic vegetation table. 40% of processed Clay contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.mud: Mangrove resource table. 45% of processed Mud contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.netherrack: Nether recovery table. Ancient Debris is a 0.01% roll; 39.99% contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.blackstone: Bastion-themed recovery table. 45% of processed Blackstone contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.end_stone: End recovery table. 50% of processed End Stone contains nothing.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.prismarine: Ocean recovery table with 2 Prismarine Shards guaranteed and independent bonus rolls.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.prismarine_br: Enhanced ocean recovery table with 4 Prismarine Shards guaranteed and independent bonus rolls.
stonecutter_sifting.viewer.dark_prismari: Rare ocean recovery table with 4 Prismarine Shards guaranteed plus ink, crystal, sponge, Heart of the Sea, and coral rolls.
